recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. A future rename from log() to trace() should require a new FHIR-I decision because FHIR-39486 explicitly chose documentation over breaking syntax changes.
issue_request: FHIR-39486 asked to rename the FHIR Mapping Language log() statement to trace() for consistency with FHIRPath; the Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution rejected the breaking rename and required documenting log as serving the same function as FHIRPath trace().
initial_application: Commit 4e43df4bce0cc1671cba2bee864a7f21654e8f82 applied the issue by adding the trace-equivalence paragraph to source/mapping-language.html, and that paragraph remains in current source.
additional_context: mapping-language.html is an active Implementation Support page linked from StructureMap, while images/mapping.g4 still uses log as the grammar keyword as expected from the non-breaking resolution. FHIR-I minutes confirm the 2023-01-30 Not Persuasive with Modification vote, and the related Zulip thread shows the origin of the consistency request without surfacing a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source edit is needed; changing log() to trace() would contradict the final resolution.
